title: Activation Ground Control KPI Roster
content:
Purpose:
A compact, daily-operational KPI roster and fallback checklist to run pre-launch through first-week scale. Designed to be used as a working sheet in cadence calls (Ground Control). Emphasis on owner rotations, measurable triggers for escalation, and quick reroute steps.

How to use:
- Update the top-line KPIs each morning before Ground Control standup (06:45 PT)
- Mark any KPI row with >thresholds in RED and add an action owner and ETA
- Use the staffing rotation table to assign primary/secondary on-call for each lane (48-hour blocks)
- If an emergency fallback is consumed, log the incident in the last column and update the rollback flag

KPI SUMMARY (daily):
Date | Target user rate | 95p latency (ms) | Error rate (%) | Cost per 1k tokens ($) | Quality regression (sample pct) | Traffic % to canary
YYYY-MM-DD | 500 rps | 220 | 0.45 | 3.20 | 0.7 | 10%

Escalation triggers (auto-check):
- 95p latency > 300ms for 15m -> page infra-sre, reduce batch size, shift traffic to dedicated pool
- Error rate > 1.0% over rolling 10m -> roll back to prior model bundle, disable autoscale burst
- Cost per 1k tokens > 1.5x projected -> throttle non-essential routes, enable quantization profile Q4-temp
- Quality regression > 2% on golden prompts -> pause rollout, notify applied-ml and product-safety

Owner rotations (example schedule):
Lane | Primary | Secondary | Block start | Block end | Notes
Inference ops | Daniel Kim | Sofia Nguyen | 2026-03-01 | 2026-03-03 | Primary for GPU pool issues
Traffic & Routing | Priya Singh | Marco Alvarez | 2026-03-01 | 2026-03-03 | Controls smart routing policy
Customer escalations | Leah Rodriguez | Daniel Kim | 2026-03-01 | 2026-03-03 | Liaison to CS and enterprise customers

Daily checklist (pre-standup):
- Verify token burn and cost delta vs rolling forecast (owner: finance-contact)
- Confirm KV cache warmup % > 85% for top 10 routes (owner: inference ops)
- Confirm canary cohort health: mean latency, 95p, error rate, sample outputs judged (owner: product)
- Validate rollout percent matches schedule and no auto-increase occurred (owner: traffic)

Fallback playbook (quick steps):
1) Auto-fallback: route 100% of traffic to stable model variant A (traffic-runbooks).
2) If cluster saturation: spin up dedicated pool (if reserved capacity exists) and shift 30% to dedicated.
3) Quality issue: revert prompts/temperature changes, apply last-known-good model artifact.
4) Cost spike: engage billing throttle, reduce inference concurrency, set emergency quota.

Post-incident log fields (to fill after event):
Timestamp | Incident lead | Trigger | Immediate action taken | Time to mitigate | Root cause (tldr) | Follow-up owner | Rollback used (y/n)

Open risks & mitigations (top 5):
- Risk: Underestimated peak 2x user concurrency in region EU-W; Mitigation: pre-warm extra dedicated nodes, set regional ramp cap 70% until validated.
- Risk: Model A has unknown tokenization regression on long-form prompts; Mitigation: run focused eval set and reduce max input length for canary.
- Risk: Key rotation schedule collides with launch day windows; Mitigation: postpone rotation, coordinate with security and SRE.

Meeting cadence & artifacts:
- Ground Control standup: daily 06:45 PT (15 min) - quick KPI readout and blockers.
- Midday sync: ad-hoc if any red trigger (>1) persists after 30 minutes.
- Post-mortem: for any incident >30m or customer impact. Link PM notes to Confluence.

Quick contacts (on-call):
- Infra-SRE Slack: #sre-oncall (primary paged)
- Inference ops pager: +1-415-555-0132 (Daniel Kim)
- Product lead on-call: +1-415-555-0178 (Leah Rodriguez)

Notes (working):
- Add granular token-level cost drilldown row for routes that exceed 10% of spend.
- Consider auto-runner that posts KPI snapshot to #ground-control at 06:40 PT
- Validate canary evaluation harness is logging sample IDs for offline quality review.

Revision history:
- 2025-09-20: initial draft (Leah)
- 2025-11-02: added automated triggers and fallback steps (Priya)
- 2026-03-05: updated contact roster and thresholds after stress test (Daniel)
